title: Please Change!
body:
I loved this app for the first little bit, I have study bunny, and I thought this was going to be just as efficient. I liked the app for a bit, then when I couldn’t use it at the minute it would decrease my levels, this really annoyed me. But then the constant 
“YOUR BUNNY’S LOSING HEALTH COME AND DO HABITS TO FIX IT!” Annoying. Also, the fact that you can’t redeem your day streak is SUPER irritating. And the fact that the shop is SO expensive! I liked this app at first, but now- not really. I think study bunny is the way to go. It’s as sufficient as this app. But I would love to re-download if you fixed these things! Keep up the good work! 😁
